name: rootcx
description: Work with RootCX and build applications securely in your local workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Build local apps and work with RootCX.
interface.longDescription: Connect to your RootCX workspace, inspect applications, validate manifests, and create approved records. The RootCX skill installs and uses the local CLI for scaffolding, builds, tests, and deployment so application source stays on your machine.
